declarations.name: todoColors
declarations.description: Colour of a task's icon tile, and the accent choices of the customize panel.

declarations.name: todoBackgrounds
declarations.description: Background presets of the customize panel. `default` follows the component's CSS variables and the theme.

A to-do list that shows its progress at a glance: a ring beside the title (or a bar, or a large hero ring), tasks
with a coloured icon tile each, filters, and an add field that picks a fitting icon from what you type. With
`customizable` a palette button opens a panel where the viewer changes the background, the accent, the progress
style, the density and each task's icon and colour; with `storage-key` those choices are remembered in
`localStorage`.

Task icons come from `@c2n/task-icons`.

members.name: headingLevel
members.description: Heading level (1-6) the title is announced with.

members.name: tasks
members.description: The tasks. Accepts a JSON array in the attribute. The list updates it as the user checks, adds and removes tasks.

members.name: progress
members.description: How progress is drawn: a ring beside the heading, a bar under it, a large ring above it, or not at all. The viewer's choice in the customize panel wins.

members.name: customizable
members.description: Shows the palette button and its customize panel.

members.name: storageKey
members.description:
Remembers the viewer's customization in `localStorage` under `c2-todo-list:<storage-key>`. Give every list on a
site its own key.

members.name: persistTasks
members.description: With `storage-key`, also remembers the tasks, which then win over the `tasks` the page provides.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Tasks cannot be checked, added, removed or edited. The look can still be customized.

members.name: look
members.description: The viewer's customization. Set it to apply a look from script; the panel and `storage-key` keep it up to date.

members.name: resetLook
members.description: Forget the viewer's customization and return to the authored look.

events.name: look-change
events.description: The viewer changed the look in the customize panel, or reset it.

events.name: tasks-change
events.description: Fired after every change to the tasks with the new list, for two-way binding.
A task was checked or unchecked. `detail.task` is the updated task.
events.name: task-toggle

events.description: A task was added from the add field.
events.name: task-add

events.description: A task was deleted. `detail.task` is the removed task.
events.name: task-remove

events.description: A task's icon or colour was changed in the customize panel.
events.name: task-change
